projects.name: CESR2 (Cession - Excel to requirement)
projects.description: Developed an AI-based system to extract Excel formulas and translate them into clear, user-friendly business explanations. Implemented backend logic using Python and Azure AI Foundry (OpenAI 4.1) to interpret formulas accurately, and built an Angular-based frontend to present formulas, mappings, and derived business logic. Worked extensively on mapping Excel tables, row and column labels, and formula dependencies to improve explanation accuracy, while ensuring structured and reliable outputs suitable for regulatory and financial use cases.

projects.name: Cession (Multi-Bank Statement Data Extraction)
projects.technologies: Python, PyMuPDF, Poppler, Azure Document Intelligence, GPT-4.1
projects.description: An intelligent document-extraction system that pulls key financial data — premium, bank fees, realized/unrealized G/L, BRT, tax paid, dividends, transfers, and account balances — from bank statement PDFs across multiple providers (Altruist, Adirondack, Bessemer, Amarillo, Park Avenue, and others). Handles both annotated 'red-mark' values and structured table fields, with account numbers parsed directly from filenames. Built using a 3-method extraction pipeline — GPT-4.1 vision on cropped regions (PyMuPDF/Poppler), direct PyMuPDF parsing, and a trained Azure Document Intelligence model — to reliably handle varying statement layouts.
